parsed.report_to_operator: Possible metric contamination on shared board: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, and the reported gain (1.104→0.959, ~13%) is far larger than +10% training data should deliver at fixed compute.
